extracted.name: Single Crust Peach Pie
extracted.description: This single-crust peach pie recipe features juicy peach slices heaped over a nutmeg-butter crumble in a pastry shell, and topped with more crumble.
ingredient_lines: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie
6 fresh peaches - pitted, skinned, and sliced
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

Cream sugar and butter together. Add flour and nutmeg; mix until crumbly. Spread 1/2 of the mixture in pie crust. Arrange peaches on top of crumb mixture. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 of crumb mixture on top of peaches.
Bake for ten minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Continue baking until golden brown, about 40 minutes..
